_approach: A Dimitri From Paris-style re-edit feel: a panned bongo call-and-response (congaHigh/congaLow) instead of a hat pattern, a disco string-hit stand-in (crash) on the very first downbeat, and a three-tom descending fill closing bar 2 the way classic disco edits mark section changes. Tightest swing in the set -- 54% MPC (engine 0.08). Reference: Dimitri From Paris 'Sacrebleu'. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
